yara al-kindi: Hey all  Yara here, joining Infra Tools (IC2) today. Quick setup checklist so I don't block anyone:
- MDM: I ordered an M2 Macshould I enroll now or wait for IT image?
- Monitor/peripherals: who to ping for dual-monitor request (I work GMT+4 evenings).
- Console access: need read/write on org 'infra-tools' and a small staging cluster quota.
- Fun fact: I grow bonsai trees and bring tiny salads to standups. :herb:

mira (people ops): Welcome Yara!! :tada:
- Enroll at https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll and pick "Company Mac - Apple Silicon" for M2. IT typically pushes the profile within 20-40 mins.
- Peripherals: fill https://forms.redwood.example/equipment -> choose "monitor kit (dual)" and mention "evening shift". We'll prioritize ergonomics.
- Console/cluster: confirm org slug (infra-tools) and I'll file IAM + quota tickets. DM me your shipping addr for stickers.

odell (devex): Hi Yara  I'm your buddy this week. Quick wins: add SSH pubkey at https://id.redwood.example/account/ssh-keys and test jump host: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 yara@jump.redwood.com`.
If you hit SSO issues, paste the error here and I'll triage. Happy to screenshare later today (GMT+4 friendly).

samir (eng): Added you to #eng and started the rotation draft. We try to avoid graveyard spells for evening folks but you'll get a PagerDuty DM once provisioned. For staging quota, put "infra-tools, small (dev)" on the form and tag me to approve faster.

asset-bot: Enrollment received for yara.ak@example.com. Device: MacBookPro (arm64). Provisioning in progress  status: pending (approx 30m).

yara al-kindi: Thanks team  enrolling now, filled the equipment form, DMing @mira my address. Odell  screenshare later today would be great (evening GMT+4). Also if anyone wants bonsai pics I'll post in #random later. :seedling:
